articles.summary:
You can now automatically enable captions on YouTube videos embedded in your feeds. Head to Preferences > Stories and check the new “YouTube Captions” option.

When enabled, any YouTube video in any story will automatically show captions when you start playing it (assuming the video has captions available). articles.title: Auto-enable captions on YouTube videos
